artDirection: oskar_world_advisor: independently viewed v4 and author tree/cloud/water references, supplied environment simplification directives; root executes imagegen.
prompt:
Edit image1 under the following ART DIRECTOR instructions. The user requests a stronger Oskar Stålberg inspired environmental style based on his specific 2024 experiments (images2–4), NOT generic detailed fantasy CGI.
Image1 is the only composition/layout target; keep its two stacked views, all building shapes and locations, current tower and domed castle architecture, bridges, stairs, railway and plaza unchanged. Do NOT redesign architecture, roads or city geometry. Images2/3/4 are STRICT ENVIRONMENTAL STYLE REFERENCES, not new layouts.
The current environment in image1 is too fragmented, shiny, highly textured and yellow-olive. Make a VISIBLY STRONG style correction across terrain, vegetation, clouds and water in both old and new city regions:
Use broad, quiet, matte colour masses like reference2/3. Rocks simplify into a few pale warm grey limestone planes and broad desaturated cool grey shadow regions; remove 70% of small chippy stone facets and pebble noise while preserving mountain silhouette and major ledges. Smooth meaningful convex transitions but keep escarpments. NO photoreal surface detail.
Replace the many tiny yellow-olive broccoli clusters with larger overlapping rounded canopy forms in LOW SATURATION PALE GREY-TEAL / sage bluegreen, matched to reference2 tree colours. Trees read as continuous calm forest shapes with softly scalloped OUTER silhouettes and only a handful of extremely thin low-contrast internal crown lines. No leaf-level modelling, no granular canopy dots, no independently outlined green balls, no dark black canopy shadows. Have 2–3 levels of crown scale, rooted on shoulders and side hills, leave cliffs bare. Keep only a few original cypresses as dark vertical accents.
Grass is a SIMPLE broad pale yellow-sage colour field, not a noisy speckled meadow. Organic rounded irregular edges with thin quiet soil transition and small bare interruptions, never coarse triangle cutouts. Grass-rock and forest-grass contrasts are clean and legible. Coherent muted forest patches cover BOTH new-city outer natural slopes and old-city shoulders. Do not put trees on buildings, foundations, bridge or tracks.
Clouds: replace hundreds of fluffy photographic cottonballs with SEVERAL connected broad soft-edged white CLOUD VOLUMES inspired by image3. Milky white major lobes, restrained pale grey-teal undersides, a few subtle internal forms, no glitter or tiny detailed puffs. Low broken banks wrap around mountain sides, one disappears behind a peak and reappears on the side; other passes through rear valley; new-city outer slope has clear front/behind depth interaction. Clouds must NOT obscure tower/dome/buildings/railway; no uniform fog blanket. Keep main slopes visible. Reduce total cloud clutter.
Water MUST remain the light muted milky grey-cyan of image4, a calm largely flat colour field with barely perceptible variation, soft under-bridge shadow, a thin discontinuous white shore wave line and sparse pale ripple. No saturated blue, navy, cyan, shiny horizon or water glitter. Make distant ocean same calm muted family.
Lighting: diffuse, clean, very soft directional light as in reference images, NO cinematic sunbeams, hard black ambient shadows, strong bloom, glossy surfaces, dramatic atmospheric perspective, gritty textures or hyperdetailed photoreal miniature look. More graphic/simple readable game art, but keep spatial form; not flat 2D cartoon.
Architecture is deliberately still the current game architecture and may be more detailed than terrain; do not change any architectural design. Preserve all panel captions; bottom text “顾问方案 · 环境目标图 · 建筑保留现状”. No additional text. This is a concept revision, not an in-game screenshot.
scope: Environment concept only. Architecture design deferred, placement/identity preserved approximately; no runtime changes and two-hour task paused.
